services.name: Art & Exhibitions
services.desc: Step into vibrant and varied stories told through American art at Crystal Bridges, where expansive galleries, breathtaking architecture, and 134 acres of Ozark forest await. From historical masterworks to contemporary gems, and classic art exhibitions to cutting-edge immersive experiences, there’s no shortage of inspiration around every corner-all with free general admission. Our permanent collection spans centuries and styles, collectively offering a superb overview of American art and important perspectives on culture, creativity, and the world around us.
